prompt: The working week should be shorter and workers should have a longer weekend.Do you agree or disagree?Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
There is an argument that the working week should be shorter and employees should have longer weekends. I completely agree with this view because having more time off can improve workers’ family lives and reduce work-related stress.

One important benefit of a longer weekend is that working parents would have more time to spend with their families. Due to high living expenses, both parents in many households need to work full-time to support their children. As a result, they may have limited time together during the week, particularly when their children attend school or childcare. Even at weekends, parents often have household chores and other responsibilities to complete. Having an additional day off could therefore give families more opportunities to spend quality time together. This may strengthen relationships between parents and children and create a healthier work-life balance.

Another reason for supporting a shorter working week is that it could reduce stress among young workers and students. Many university students, for example, need to work while studying in order to cover their living and educational expenses. Managing both responsibilities can be stressful and exhausting, especially when they have little time to rest. A longer weekend would allow them to recover from work, focus on their studies and have some time for themselves. Consequently, they may experience less stress and return to work feeling more energetic and motivated.

In conclusion, I believe that employees should have a shorter working week and a longer weekend. An additional day off could enable working parents to spend more time with their children and help workers and students achieve a healthier balance between their responsibilities and personal lives.
